plugins.description: Skills for working with local Beancount ledgers through a coding agent: init, add, trade, property, import, importer-author, reconcile, migrate, ask, roll-forward, accruals, invoices, close, options. Needs `bea` 0.3.1 or later for checks, queries, and writes.
